rubric.why: Mitosis is the division of the nucleus.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that mitosis involves division of the nucleus.

rubric.why: Mitosis produces daughter nuclei that retain the parent cell’s chromosome number.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that two genetically identical daughter nuclei are produced, or that they have the same chromosome number as the parent nucleus.

modelAnswer: Mitosis is the division of a cell’s nucleus into two genetically identical daughter nuclei.
The daughter nuclei have the same number of chromosomes as the parent nucleus.

rubric.why: Catabolism breaks complex molecules into simpler substances.
rubric.description: Describes catabolism as the breakdown of complex molecules.

rubric.why: Anabolism builds complex molecules from simpler substances and requires energy.
rubric.description: Describes anabolism as synthesis that requires energy.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly describing anabolism as building complex molecules from simpler substances and requiring energy.

modelAnswer: Catabolism breaks complex molecules into simpler substances and releases energy.
Anabolism builds complex molecules from simpler substances and requires energy.

items.followUp: Write down two ways enzymes help living organisms.

rubric.why: Enzymes help break down food during digestion.
rubric.description: Gives digestion of food as a use of enzymes.

rubric.why: Enzymes are used in detergents to remove stains.
rubric.description: Gives the use of enzymes in detergents.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that enzymes are used in detergents to remove stains.

Enzymes are used in detergents to remove stains.
